note: Sharing a film with someone, then chatting about your favourite scene, is a simple way to feel connected. Even a quick message about it counts.

word.fact: “Scene” comes from the Greek “skēnē”, the tent or hut at the back of an ancient Greek stage where actors changed costumes.

hue.name: Lights down
hue.note: Indigo was named as one of the seven rainbow colours by Isaac Newton, who chose seven partly to echo the notes of a musical scale.
